card.name: Crime reports before victims or targets
card.fires_on: Words in news-style accounts of kidnappings, killings, attacks or seizures, often a perpetrator or linking word such as 'a', 'in', 'by' or 'after' just before the victim, place or target is named.

modes.label: Perpetrator words
modes.description: Words naming the attackers, such as kidnappers, men or perpetrators, in reports of violent crime.
modes.example: On March 1, 1932, kidn<<appers>> snatched Little Lindy from the family

modes.label: Linking words in crime reports
modes.description: Small words like a, in, by or after inside sentences about killings, mobs or police seizures.
modes.example: In July<< a>> mob killed a suspected thief by beating him

card.writes: It pushes the model toward the word 'targets' and related target terms, and away from some Chinese words about policy and crime.
card.plain: It lights up in news reports of killings and attacks, in the words leading up to who or what was attacked.
